spec.title: Celebrity Traitors: Gameplay Analysis
spec.description: Who played the best game in series 2 of UK Celebrity Traitors? SQL expressions over CSV data.

options.content:
# Celebrity Traitors: who played the best game?

> ### 🏆 **Kenny** played the best game overall. **Sebastian** was the best faithful.

The data records **outcomes and votes**, not persuasion or the social game, so each side is judged on its own aim:

| | 🗡️ Traitor | 🛡️ Faithful |
|---|---|---|
| **The aim** | Stay undetected. | Find the traitors. |
| **The measure** | Faithful votes drawn per round table. | Votes that landed on a traitor, and surviving to the end. |

📺 The show aired on the BBC in October 2026. If you have access to the iPlayer, you can [watch here](https://www.bbc.co.uk/iplayer/episodes/m002csng/the-celebrity-traitors?seriesId=m002csng-structural-2-m0030pxs).

Everything here is read live from CSV files using the **Infinity data source**, and **every figure is a SQL expression**. Open any panel and look at query **Z**.

spec.expression:
WITH t AS (
  SELECT player, roundTable FROM A WHERE status = 'traitor' AND roundTable IS NOT NULL
), v AS (
  SELECT votedFor, roundTable, SUM(votes) AS votes
  FROM A
  WHERE status = 'faithful' AND votedFor IS NOT NULL AND votedFor <> ''
  GROUP BY votedFor, roundTable
), tr AS (
  SELECT t.player, COUNT(*) AS rts, COALESCE(SUM(v.votes), 0) AS votes_against
  FROM t LEFT JOIN v ON v.votedFor = t.player AND v.roundTable = t.roundTable
  GROUP BY t.player
)
SELECT 'Best traitor' AS award,
       CONCAT('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/simonprickett/celebrity-traitors-workshop/main/data/images/', tr.player, '.webp') AS photo,
       CONCAT('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/simonprickett/celebrity-traitors-workshop/main/data/images/', tr.player, '_out.webp') AS after_leaving,
       COALESCE(NULLIF(b.knownAs, ''), CONCAT(b.firstName, ' ', b.lastName)) AS contestant,
       CONCAT(tr.votes_against, ' faithful votes against, over ', tr.rts, ' round tables') AS why
FROM tr JOIN B b ON b.name = tr.player
ORDER BY tr.votes_against / tr.rts ASC, tr.rts DESC
LIMIT 1

spec.title: Kenny: round tables as a traitor
spec.description: Round tables Kenny attended while a traitor (round tables 5 to 10).

spec.expression:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS round_tables_as_traitor
FROM A
WHERE player = 'kenny' AND status = 'traitor' AND roundTable IS NOT NULL

spec.title: Kenny: faithful votes against him
spec.description: Votes cast by faithful players against Kenny at the round tables where he was a traitor. Nobody voted for him.

spec.expression:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(v.votes), 0) AS faithful_votes_against
FROM A v
JOIN A t ON t.player = v.votedFor AND t.roundTable = v.roundTable
WHERE v.votedFor = 'kenny' AND t.status = 'traitor' AND v.status = 'faithful'

spec.title: Kenny: votes at traitors, as faithful
spec.description: Before he was recruited, Kenny's vote landed on a traitor in 3 of 4 votes: the best hit rate, from a small sample.

spec.expression:
SELECT CONCAT(SUM(CASE WHEN t.player IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), ' of ', COUNT(*)) AS faithful_votes_at_traitors
FROM A v
LEFT JOIN A t ON t.player = v.votedFor AND t.roundTable = v.roundTable AND t.status = 'traitor'
WHERE v.player = 'kenny' AND v.status = 'faithful' AND v.votedFor <> ''

spec.title: Kenny: dagger votes
spec.description: Votes counted using the dagger power (2 each, in round tables 7 and 8).

spec.expression:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(votes), 0) AS dagger_votes
FROM A
WHERE player = 'kenny' AND power = 'dagger'

spec.title: Traitor leaderboard
spec.description: Lower is better for a traitor. Votes against only counts votes cast by players who were faithful at that round table; a dagger vote counts as 2.

spec.expression:
WITH t AS (
  SELECT player, roundTable FROM A WHERE status = 'traitor' AND roundTable IS NOT NULL
), v AS (
  SELECT votedFor, roundTable, SUM(votes) AS votes
  FROM A
  WHERE status = 'faithful' AND votedFor IS NOT NULL AND votedFor <> ''
  GROUP BY votedFor, roundTable
)
SELECT CONCAT('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/simonprickett/celebrity-traitors-workshop/main/data/images/', t.player, '.webp') AS photo,
       COALESCE(NULLIF(b.knownAs, ''), CONCAT(b.firstName, ' ', b.lastName)) AS traitor,
       COUNT(*) AS round_tables,
       COALESCE(SUM(v.votes), 0) AS faithful_votes_against,
       ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(v.votes), 0) / COUNT(*), 2) AS votes_per_round_table
FROM t
LEFT JOIN v ON v.votedFor = t.player AND v.roundTable = t.roundTable
JOIN B b ON b.name = t.player
GROUP BY t.player, b.firstName, b.lastName, b.knownAs
ORDER BY votes_per_round_table ASC, round_tables DESC

spec.title: Faithful votes against each traitor, by round table
spec.description: Shows when each traitor was under suspicion. Kenny only appears from round table 5, when he became a traitor, and he never has a vote against him.

spec.expression:
WITH t AS (
  SELECT player, roundTable FROM A WHERE status = 'traitor' AND roundTable IS NOT NULL
), v AS (
  SELECT votedFor, roundTable, SUM(votes) AS votes
  FROM A
  WHERE status = 'faithful' AND votedFor IS NOT NULL AND votedFor <> ''
  GROUP BY votedFor, roundTable
)
SELECT CONCAT('RT ', t.roundTable) AS round_table, b.firstName AS traitor, COALESCE(v.votes, 0) AS faithful_votes
FROM t
LEFT JOIN v ON v.votedFor = t.player AND v.roundTable = t.roundTable
JOIN B b ON b.name = t.player
ORDER BY t.roundTable

spec.title: Faithful leaderboard
spec.description: Votes cast while faithful that landed on a player who was a traitor at that round table. Ordered by the number of hits, then by hit rate. Small samples (Kenny, Bella, Myha'la) flatter the percentage.

spec.expression:
WITH f AS (
  SELECT v.player, CASE WHEN t.player IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS hit
  FROM A v
  LEFT JOIN A t ON t.player = v.votedFor AND t.roundTable = v.roundTable AND t.status = 'traitor'
  WHERE v.status = 'faithful' AND v.votedFor IS NOT NULL AND v.votedFor <> ''
), s AS (
  SELECT player, COUNT(DISTINCT episode) AS shield_episodes FROM A WHERE shield = 'true' GROUP BY player
)
SELECT CONCAT('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/simonprickett/celebrity-traitors-workshop/main/data/images/', f.player, '.webp') AS photo,
       COALESCE(NULLIF(b.knownAs, ''), CONCAT(b.firstName, ' ', b.lastName)) AS faithful,
       COUNT(*) AS votes_cast,
       SUM(f.hit) AS votes_at_traitors,
       ROUND(100 * SUM(f.hit) / COUNT(*)) AS hit_rate_pct,
       COALESCE(s.shield_episodes, 0) AS shield_episodes
FROM f
JOIN B b ON b.name = f.player
LEFT JOIN s ON s.player = f.player
GROUP BY f.player, b.firstName, b.lastName, b.knownAs, s.shield_episodes
ORDER BY votes_at_traitors DESC, hit_rate_pct DESC

spec.title: Votes that landed on a traitor
spec.description: Count of votes at traitors while faithful. Raw counts are used rather than percentages because the sample sizes differ a lot.

spec.expression:
WITH f AS (
  SELECT v.player, CASE WHEN t.player IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS hit
  FROM A v
  LEFT JOIN A t ON t.player = v.votedFor AND t.roundTable = v.roundTable AND t.status = 'traitor'
  WHERE v.status = 'faithful' AND v.votedFor IS NOT NULL AND v.votedFor <> ''
), s AS (
  SELECT player, COUNT(DISTINCT episode) AS shield_episodes FROM A WHERE shield = 'true' GROUP BY player
)
SELECT CONCAT('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/simonprickett/celebrity-traitors-workshop/main/data/images/', f.player, '.webp') AS photo,
       COALESCE(NULLIF(b.knownAs, ''), CONCAT(b.firstName, ' ', b.lastName)) AS faithful,
       COUNT(*) AS votes_cast,
       SUM(f.hit) AS votes_at_traitors,
       ROUND(100 * SUM(f.hit) / COUNT(*)) AS hit_rate_pct,
       COALESCE(s.shield_episodes, 0) AS shield_episodes
FROM f
JOIN B b ON b.name = f.player
LEFT JOIN s ON s.player = f.player
GROUP BY f.player, b.firstName, b.lastName, b.knownAs, s.shield_episodes
ORDER BY votes_at_traitors DESC, hit_rate_pct DESC

spec.title: Kenny's game, vote by vote
spec.description: Kenny's vote at every round table he attended. The status colour changes from faithful to traitor after round table 4: he was recruited in episode 5 after that round table, so he voted at it as a faithful. The photo is the player he voted for.

spec.expression:
SELECT a.episode, a.roundTable AS round_table, a.status,
       CASE WHEN a.votedFor <> '' THEN CONCAT('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/simonprickett/celebrity-traitors-workshop/main/data/images/', a.votedFor, '.webp') ELSE NULL END AS voted_for_photo,
       vb.firstName AS voted_for, a.votes, a.power
FROM A a
LEFT JOIN B vb ON vb.name = a.votedFor
WHERE a.player = 'kenny' AND a.roundTable IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY a.episode, a.roundTable

spec.title: Who left the game, and when
spec.description: Everyone banished or murdered in the main game. Photos are the _out images. The Contestant cell is green if the player was faithful when they left and red if they were a traitor. Traitors caught by banishment: Richard, Hannah, James and Maya.

spec.expression:
SELECT a.episode, a.roundTable AS round_table,
       CONCAT('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/simonprickett/celebrity-traitors-workshop/main/data/images/', a.player, '_out.webp') AS photo,
       COALESCE(NULLIF(b.knownAs, ''), CONCAT(b.firstName, ' ', b.lastName)) AS contestant,
       a.outcome
FROM A a
JOIN B b ON b.name = a.player
WHERE a.outcome IN ('banished', 'murdered')
ORDER BY a.episode, a.roundTable

spec.title: The end game
spec.description: Rounds 1 to 4. The Contestant cell is green for a faithful player and red for a traitor. Photos switch to the _out image for the player banished that round. After a tie in round 2 the next round is a tie-break, where tied players sit out and everyone's decision repeats.

spec.expression:
SELECT c.round,
       CASE WHEN c.outcome = 'banished' THEN CONCAT('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/simonprickett/celebrity-traitors-workshop/main/data/images/', c.player, '_out.webp')
            ELSE CONCAT('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/simonprickett/celebrity-traitors-workshop/main/data/images/', c.player, '.webp') END AS photo,
       COALESCE(NULLIF(b.knownAs, ''), CONCAT(b.firstName, ' ', b.lastName)) AS contestant,
       CASE c.decision WHEN 'end' THEN '👍 End' WHEN 'continue' THEN '👎 Continue' ELSE c.decision END AS decision, vb.firstName AS voted_for, c.outcome
FROM C c
JOIN B b ON b.name = c.player
LEFT JOIN B vb ON vb.name = c.votedFor
ORDER BY c.round, c.player

options.content:
### How these figures are calculated

1. **Data:** each panel loads `main_game.csv`, `contestants.csv` and/or `end_game.csv` using the **Infinity** data source. The CSVs are provided with the workshop data. The photos are provided with the workshop data too.
2. **SQL:** each figure is a **SQL expression** over those CSV queries. Open a panel and look at query **Z**.
3. **"At a traitor":** a vote counts if the player voted for was a traitor at the **same round table**. "Faithful votes against" only counts votes from players who were faithful at that table, and a **dagger** vote counts as 2.
4. **Status changes:** Kenny is faithful until the episode 5 round table and a traitor from episode 6, so he appears in both the traitor and faithful tables.

> ⚠️ **Caveats:** samples are small (Kenny's faithful accuracy rests on 4 votes); winners are read from the `winner` markers in the end game data; other definitions of "best" would give other answers.

spec.title: Sebastian: round tables attended
spec.description: Round tables Sebastian attended. He was at every one of the ten, as a faithful.

spec.expression:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS round_tables_attended
FROM A
WHERE player = 'sebastian' AND roundTable IS NOT NULL

spec.title: Sebastian: votes at traitors
spec.description: Votes cast that landed on a player who was a traitor at that round table: the most of any faithful.

spec.expression:
SELECT CONCAT(SUM(CASE WHEN t.player IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), ' of ', COUNT(*)) AS votes_at_traitors
FROM A v
LEFT JOIN A t ON t.player = v.votedFor AND t.roundTable = v.roundTable AND t.status = 'traitor'
WHERE v.player = 'sebastian' AND v.status = 'faithful' AND v.votedFor <> ''

spec.title: Sebastian: episodes with a shield
spec.description: Episodes in which Sebastian held a shield (2 and 4).

spec.expression:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT episode) AS episodes_with_shield
FROM A
WHERE player = 'sebastian' AND shield = 'true'

spec.title: Sebastian: end game result
spec.description: Marked as winner in the final end game round.

spec.expression:
SELECT CONCAT('🏆 ', UPPER(LEFT(outcome, 1)), SUBSTRING(outcome, 2)) AS end_game_result
FROM C
WHERE player = 'sebastian' AND outcome = 'winner'

spec.title: Sebastian's game, vote by vote
spec.description: Sebastian's vote at every round table, with the status the player he voted for had at that round table (traitor means the vote landed). The photo is the player he voted for.

spec.expression:
SELECT a.episode, a.roundTable AS round_table, a.status,
       CASE WHEN a.votedFor <> '' THEN CONCAT('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/simonprickett/celebrity-traitors-workshop/main/data/images/', a.votedFor, '.webp') ELSE NULL END AS voted_for_photo,
       vb.firstName AS voted_for,
       CASE WHEN t.player IS NOT NULL THEN 'traitor' ELSE 'faithful' END AS voted_for_was,
       a.votes, a.power
FROM A a
LEFT JOIN B vb ON vb.name = a.votedFor
LEFT JOIN A t ON t.player = a.votedFor AND t.roundTable = a.roundTable AND t.status = 'traitor'
WHERE a.player = 'sebastian' AND a.roundTable IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY a.episode, a.roundTable

options.content:
🗡️ Why Kenny?

  • Recruited in episode 5, after that round table, so he voted at it as a faithful.
  • As a traitor he attended 6 round tables and no faithful ever voted for him.
  • Used the dagger in episode 8, doubling his vote in both round tables (Sharon, then Joanne).
  • Reached the end game, where Romesh and Sebastian voted him out in round 3.
  • The other traitors were voted for far more: Maya 3, James 5, Richard 13 and Hannah 17 faithful votes.

🛡️ Why Sebastian?

  • Cast 5 votes that landed on a traitor, more than any other faithful (James, Leigh-Anne and Romesh had 4).
  • Voted for Richard (round table 1), Hannah (round tables 3 and 4), James (9) and Maya (10), all traitors at the time.
  • Held a shield in episodes 2 and 4.
  • Reached the end game, voted for Kenny in rounds 2 and 3, and is marked winner in the final round.
  • Small samples flatter percentages, so raw counts are used rather than hit rates.

spec.expression:
WITH f AS (
  SELECT x.player, CASE WHEN y.player IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS hit
  FROM A x
  LEFT JOIN A y ON y.player = x.votedFor AND y.roundTable = x.roundTable AND y.status = 'traitor'
  WHERE x.status = 'faithful' AND x.votedFor IS NOT NULL AND x.votedFor <> ''
), fr AS (
  SELECT player, SUM(hit) AS hits, COUNT(*) AS votes_cast FROM f GROUP BY player
)
SELECT 'Best faithful' AS award,
       CONCAT('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/simonprickett/celebrity-traitors-workshop/main/data/images/', fr.player, '.webp') AS photo,
       CONCAT('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/simonprickett/celebrity-traitors-workshop/main/data/images/', fr.player, '_out.webp') AS after_leaving,
       COALESCE(NULLIF(b.knownAs, ''), CONCAT(b.firstName, ' ', b.lastName)) AS contestant,
       CONCAT(fr.hits, ' of ', fr.votes_cast, ' votes landed on a traitor') AS why
FROM fr JOIN B b ON b.name = fr.player
ORDER BY fr.hits DESC, fr.hits / fr.votes_cast DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH t AS (
  SELECT player, roundTable FROM A WHERE status = 'traitor' AND roundTable IS NOT NULL
), v AS (
  SELECT votedFor, roundTable, SUM(votes) AS votes
  FROM A
  WHERE status = 'faithful' AND votedFor IS NOT NULL AND votedFor <> ''
  GROUP BY votedFor, roundTable
), tr AS (
  SELECT t.player, COUNT(*) AS rts, COALESCE(SUM(v.votes), 0) AS votes_against
  FROM t LEFT JOIN v ON v.votedFor = t.player AND v.roundTable = t.roundTable
  GROUP BY t.player
)
SELECT CONCAT(tr.player, CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM A WHERE A.player = tr.player AND A.outcome IN ('banished','murdered')) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM C WHERE C.player = tr.player AND C.outcome = 'banished') > 0 THEN '_out' ELSE '' END) AS player FROM tr JOIN B b ON b.name = tr.player ORDER BY tr.votes_against / tr.rts ASC, tr.rts DESC LIMIT 1

WITH f AS (
  SELECT x.player, CASE WHEN y.player IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS hit
  FROM A x
  LEFT JOIN A y ON y.player = x.votedFor AND y.roundTable = x.roundTable AND y.status = 'traitor'
  WHERE x.status = 'faithful' AND x.votedFor IS NOT NULL AND x.votedFor <> ''
), fr AS (
  SELECT player, SUM(hit) AS hits, COUNT(*) AS votes_cast FROM f GROUP BY player
)
SELECT CONCAT(fr.player, CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM A WHERE A.player = fr.player AND A.outcome IN ('banished','murdered')) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM C WHERE C.player = fr.player AND C.outcome = 'banished') > 0 THEN '_out' ELSE '' END) AS player FROM fr JOIN B b ON b.name = fr.player ORDER BY fr.hits DESC, fr.hits / fr.votes_cast DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT CONCAT('kenny', CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM A WHERE A.player = 'kenny' AND A.outcome IN ('banished','murdered')) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM C WHERE C.player = 'kenny' AND C.outcome = 'banished') > 0 THEN '_out' ELSE '' END) AS player FROM B WHERE name = 'kenny'

SELECT CONCAT('sebastian', CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM A WHERE A.player = 'sebastian' AND A.outcome IN ('banished','murdered')) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM C WHERE C.player = 'sebastian' AND C.outcome = 'banished') > 0 THEN '_out' ELSE '' END) AS player FROM B WHERE name = 'sebastian'

options.content:
## 📊 The numbers behind the verdict

Kenny and Sebastian won their categories, but how did everyone else do? **Traitors** are ranked by how few faithful votes they drew per round table, and **faithful players** by how many of their votes landed on a traitor. After the leaderboards, see who left the game and when, and how the end game played out.
